note: One motivated move per shot. Combine at most 2-3 bracket commands in Hailuo syntax. Avoid contradictory instructions (e.g., static + orbit). Sources: Kling official camera guide, Runway prompting docs, Veo 3.1 guide, Luma 1.6 motion list, Hailuo [command] syntax, Seedance capability map, Higgsfield WAN camera blog.

movements.prompt_phrasing: "Slow dolly-in toward [subject]" / "Camera slowly pushes in on [subject] to emphasize [emotion/detail]" / Hailuo: [Push in]
movements.when_to_use: Building intimacy or tension; revealing detail; product glamour (85mm equivalent)

movements.prompt_phrasing: "Slow pull-back revealing [environment]" / Hailuo: [Pull out]
movements.when_to_use: Creating distance, reflection, or scale reveals; ending shots

movements.prompt_phrasing: "Tracking shot alongside [subject] as [action]" / "Low aerial tracking" / Hailuo: [Tracking shot]
movements.when_to_use: Following moving subjects (walks, runs, vehicles); matching subject pace sells realism

movements.prompt_phrasing: "Slow 180-degree orbit around [subject]" / "360-degree orbit" / Luma: "camera orbit right"
movements.when_to_use: Showcasing a subject from all sides (product, fashion, hero moments); dream sequences

movements.prompt_phrasing: "Crane shot rising from ground level" / "Crane up revealing [vista]" / Luma: "camera crane up"
movements.when_to_use: Epic reveals; moving from intimate detail to grand scale (or reverse)

movements.prompt_phrasing: Hailuo: [Pedestal up] / [Pedestal down]; prose: "camera rises vertically"
movements.when_to_use: Vertical reveals without the swing of a crane; product and architectural shots

movements.prompt_phrasing: Hailuo: [Truck left] / [Truck right]; prose: "camera slides laterally"
movements.when_to_use: Parallax reveals; following action across a scene; keeping framing constant while shifting viewpoint

movements.prompt_phrasing: "Slow, stable pan left across [scene], no sudden motion" / Hailuo: [Pan left] / Luma: "camera pan left"
movements.when_to_use: Surveying landscapes; following lateral action; transitions between subjects

movements.prompt_phrasing: "Camera tilts cautiously, revealing [doorway]" / Hailuo: [Tilt up] / [Tilt down]
movements.when_to_use: Revealing height or depth; horror/suspense reveals; establishing scale

movements.prompt_phrasing: "Whip pan to [subject]"
movements.when_to_use: Energetic transitions; comedy; action punctuation (use sparingly)

movements.prompt_phrasing: "Crash zoom into [subject's] face"
movements.when_to_use: Comedy beats; shock reveals; high-energy punctuation

movements.prompt_phrasing: Hailuo: [Zoom in] / [Zoom out]; prose: "gradual zoom"
movements.when_to_use: Slow emphasis without moving the camera body; surveillance/documentary feel

movements.prompt_phrasing: "Rack focus from [foreground] to [background]" / "Pull focus from background to label as the camera moves closer"
movements.when_to_use: Shifting story attention between planes; product label reveals; dialogue subtext

movements.prompt_phrasing: "Handheld follow" / "Handheld micro-shake" / "Shoulder-cam drift" / Hailuo: [Shake]
movements.when_to_use: Documentary realism; urgency; found-footage; killing the over-polished AI look

movements.prompt_phrasing: "Smooth gimbal glide" / "Stabilized tracking"
movements.when_to_use: Luxury/commercial feel; car spots; fashion; when handheld would read as error

movements.prompt_phrasing: "Static locked-off shot" / "Static tripod shot" / Hailuo: [Static shot]; never "the camera doesn't move"
movements.when_to_use: Timelapse; dialogue coverage; product stills; letting performance carry the shot

movements.prompt_phrasing: "Drone pull-back over [landscape]" / "Aerial pan across [city]"
movements.when_to_use: Establishing geography; openings; epic scale

movements.prompt_phrasing: "First-person POV walking through [space]"
movements.when_to_use: Immersion; horror; action sequences

movements.prompt_phrasing: "Over-the-shoulder shot of [subject] facing [scene]"
movements.when_to_use: Dialogue coverage; grounding the viewer in a character's perspective

movements.prompt_phrasing: "Bird's eye view of [scene]"
movements.when_to_use: Patterns, crowds, tableaus; omniscient storytelling beats

movements.prompt_phrasing: "Tilted Dutch angle, 15 degrees"
movements.when_to_use: Unease, disorientation, psychological tension

movements.prompt_phrasing: "Slow-motion capture at the moment of [action]" (Seedance: Standard tier, single key action)
movements.when_to_use: Emphasizing peak action; fashion fabric; emotional beats
